note: Rule titles are short paraphrases, not the MISRA text. cppcheck checks a subset of MISRA C:2012. This code was not written to MISRA, so no compliance is claimed.

15.6: Loop and if bodies must be compound statements
Single-line bodies without braces. Not changed.
15.5: Early returns on errors. Not changed.
12.3: Mostly several variables declared or advanced in one statement. Not changed.
10.4: Operands of the same essential type category
Mixed int and float arithmetic. Reviewed as part of the float build tests. Not changed.
17.7: Use the return value of non-void functions
Ignored returns, mostly status of helpers. Not changed.
10.3: No assignment to a narrower or different essential type
Narrowing into fixed-width protocol fields. Not changed.
14.4: Controlling expressions must be essentially Boolean
Integer flags used as conditions. Not changed.
8.7: External linkage used in one file only
10.8: Composite expression cast to a wider or different type
20.7: X-macro parameters used as names, where parentheses are not possible. Not changed.
14.1: Includes bm_wrap_pi, which can hang on a very large angle. See DEF-5. Open.
15.7: if ... else if ends with else
13.3: Increment with no other side effect in the expression
Index updates such as free_idx[nf++]. Not changed.
2.2: One store at bmpc_mpc.c:176. Not reviewed further.
15.4: At most one break per loop

other.bugprone-implicit-widening-of-multiplica: int index products used as pointer offsets. Bounded by BMPC_N_MAX = 32, far from overflow. Not changed.
other.clang-analyzer-deadcode.DeadStores: Initial value of alpha in bmpc_post.c is always overwritten. Harmless. Not changed.
other.redundantInitialization: Same alpha initialization as the dead store above.
other.variableScope: Scope of j in bmpc_qp.c could be narrower. Style. Not changed.
other.bugprone-branch-clone: Two branches with the same body: in bmpc_qp.c, fixed bounds and an active lower bound both fix the variable at the lower bound. In safety_ctrl.c, an empty else kept on purpose. Not changed.

safety_layer.15.5: Early returns on invalid frames and in the plausibility state machine. Restructuring would change control flow in tested safety code for an advisory rule.
safety_layer.2.5: Macros used by platform/s32k312/main.c and the tests, which are outside the analyzed scope.
safety_layer.8.7: bs_make_ctrl_frame has external linkage so the unit tests can check the CTRL_CMD encoding.
safety_layer.11.5: CAN send callback receives its context as void *, the usual C callback pattern.
safety_layer.bugprone-branch-clone: Empty else branch kept on purpose after if ... else if.
